scope_outcomes.criterion: The supplied citing text must substantively interpret Max Weber in relation to at least one engagement theme or introduce a thematically relevant concern.
scope_outcomes.basis: The text explicitly attributes the origins of political capitalism to Max Weber and develops a substantive interpretation of political capitalism through tax-farming, politically constituted rent, asset-price support and working-class political fragmentation.
limitations: The source is coauthored by Dylan Riley and Robert Brenner, so the rows report the text's joint position rather than isolating Riley's individual contribution.
The source does not substantively address all plan themes, especially closure, status honour, bureaucracy, patrimonialism and meaning.
The held sample is not the authors' complete work or the thinker's entire reception.

evidence_state.coverage_basis: reader/reviewer report; source bytes do not establish inspection or completeness
blocking_issues: One or more declared finding references lack retained verified evidence
